title: SkoTx
tagline: SkoTx pioneers EVM dark pools, enhancing Web3 transactions with unmatched privacy and security.  With an intuitive and user-friendly UX, users are safer from (Intent) MEV.
description:
SkoTx pioneers the development of EVM dark pools to revolutionize privacy and security in Web3 transactions. Our project aims to mitigate the risks people face nowadays when using blockchains, including Intent MEV and other sophisticated security breaches. By integrating advanced technologies and user-friendly interfaces, we ensure that users can transact safely and efficiently.


Key Features:

EVM Dark Pools: Our dark pools allow users to trade with enhanced privacy, shielding their transactions from prying eyes and potential exploits.

Intuitive UX: Leveraging Dynamics Wallet and Base Smart Wallets, we offer a seamless onboarding process for both novice and experienced users. New users can start with familiar accounts like Google, while advanced users benefit from features as multiple wallets management.

Security Focused: Beyond Intent MEV, our solution protects against various security threats, including front-running, sandwich attacks, back-running, replay attacks, and smart contract vulnerabilities.

ERC20 port to fhEVM: We take advantage of the latest cryptographic advancements in the industry, enabling all ERC20 to be ported into an fhEVM, which was until recently, a concept basically unheard of.

Dark Pool Creation: Our upcoming feature will allow users to create their own pools, enhancing liquidity and customization within our platform.


In summary, SkoTx is dedicated to providing a secure, user-friendly platform for Web3 transactions, protecting users from the most novel to traditional exploits,  while enhancing the overall experience of trading and transacting on the blockchain.
how_its_made:
In short, SkoTx leverages a combination of cutting-edge technologies and tools to build a secure and user-friendly platform for Web3 transactions.

Frontend:

Frameworks and Languages: We used Next.js as main framework, TypeScript, Tailwind and Shadcn UI.

Account Abstraction: Integrated Dynamics SDK and Base’s Smart Wallet to enable seamless account abstraction and passkeys, making the user experience intuitive and secure.

Token Price API: Utilized The Graph to fetch real-time token prices, ensuring users have accurate information for their transactions.


Backend:

Smart Contracts: Developed with Solidity and deployed on Inco fhEVM, utilizing Zama for full homomorphic encryption.

Deployment and Cross-Chain: Used Base Spolia for smart contract deployment and Hyperlink for cross-chain contract calls and token porting, ensuring interoperability and scalability across different blockchain networks.
